::: {#def-cartesian-product-many}
#### Cartesian product of several sets

For a natural number $n$ and sets $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$,
the **Cartesian product** $A_1 \times A_2 \times \cdots \times A_n$
is the set of $n$-tuples (@def-tuple) whose $i$th entry is in $A_i$ for each $i$
[@wikipedia_cartesian_product]:

$$
A_1 \times \cdots \times A_n \eqdef \set{(a_1, \ldots, a_n) : a_i \in A_i \text{ for each } i}.
$$

For $n = 2$ this is @def-cartesian-product.

:::
